turns.instruction: Build M-INT-032 using the tables. Member DG1 has only its start node B2 recorded; its end node is missing. Preserve the explicit geometry and loads. Report signed Ux and Uz at apex AP at (7.5,0,2.5) m, left support B0 reactions Fx and Fz, and axial force N in the first bottom chord BC0. Include the node/member ID, position, global direction or axial tension/compression sign, m or kN units, load case D and current turn for every result. Use positive N for tension. Use a fresh OpenSees run after each physical change and retain its input, version, settings, successful log, raw-result mapping. Ask about unresolved essential input before reporting numerical results.
